-- Names are untrusted. Only a plain file name, with no directory part,
-- is ever opened, and only inside the capability confined to `notes`.

is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or name.split("/").len() == 1
  ex is_plain_name("notes.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  name != "" and name != "." and name != ".." and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1

-- True only if `name` is a plain name and `notes/name` can be read.
-- A missing or unreadable file gives False.
can_read(name: str) -> bool uses fs =
  post is_plain_name(name) or out == False
  ex can_read("../secret") == False
  if is_plain_name(name) == False
    return False
  let text = fs.read(name) else ""
  text != ""

-- Counts the names that can be read from `notes`.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0 and out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  ex count_readable(["../secret"]) == 0
  var n = 0
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      if can_read(name)
        n += 1
  n
